hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$file" == *.go ]]; then gofmt -w "$file" 2>/dev/null; elif [[ "$file" == *.ts || "$file" == *.tsx || "$file" == *.js || "$file" == *.jsx || "$file" == *.css || "$file" == *.html ]]; then cd frontend && npx prettier --write "${file#frontend/}" 2>/dev/null; fi
file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.db|*.db-shm|*.db-wal|*.exe|*.env|*.env.*) echo 'BLOCK: Direct edits to this file type are not allowed.' >&2; exit 1;; esac
